import json

import requests
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth

from src.runtime.api_helpers import extract, get_runtime_params

BASE_URL = "https://miterbrands-iccfjb-dev4.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com"
DRAFT_PO_ENDPOINT = f"{BASE_URL}/fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/draftPurchaseOrders"


def create_po(username: str, password: str) -> requests.Response:
    payload = {
        "ProcurementBUId": 300000003547689,
        "RequisitioningBUId": 300000003547689,
        "Buyer": "CNV, FUSDEV",
        "Supplier": "New Test Runner",
        "SupplierSite": "123",
        "CurrencyCode": "USD",
        "Description": "PO created for API testing by AP",
        "PaymentTerms": "NET 30",
        "BillToLocation": "Shared Service Location",
        "DefaultShipToLocation": "Tacoma WA",
        "PayOnReceiptFlag": False,
        "BuyerManagedTransportFlag": False,
        "lines": [
            {
                "LineNumber": 1,
                "LineType": "Goods",
                "Description": "Expense Item",
                "CategoryCode": "MISC_ASSET",
                "Quantity": 1,
                "Price": 100,
                "UOM": "EACH",
                "schedules": [
                    {
                        "ScheduleNumber": 1,
                        "ShipToOrganization": "105 Tacoma BU_ORG",
                        "ShipToLocation": "Tacoma WA",
                        "Quantity": 1,
                        "InspectionRequiredFlag": False,
                        "ReceiptRequiredFlag": False,
                        "InvoiceMatchOption": "Order",
                        "ReceiptRouting": "Direct delivery",
                        "AccrueAtReceiptFlag": False,
                        "MatchApprovalLevelCode": "2-Way",
                        "ReceiptCloseTolerancePercent": 0,
                        "InvoiceCloseTolerancePercent": 0,
                        "distributions": [
                            {
                                "DistributionNumber": 1,
                                "Quantity": 1,
                                "DeliverToLocation": "Tacoma WA",
                            }
                        ],
                    }
                ],
            }
        ],
    }

    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Accept": "application/json",
    }

    return requests.post(
        DRAFT_PO_ENDPOINT,
        auth=HTTPBasicAuth(username, password),
        headers=headers,
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        timeout=60,
    )

import json
import time
import requests
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth

from src.runtime.api_helpers import extract, get_runtime_params

BASE_URL = "https://miterbrands-iccfjb-dev4.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com"

# get_runtime_params() returns the resolved params (Excel + inline) as a flat dict.
# po_header_id is the draftPurchaseOrders primary key (the value in the URL) — in a
# flow, have the create step extract POHeaderId and pass it here via flow context.
p = get_runtime_params()
username = str(p.get("username") or "").strip()
password = str(p.get("password") or "").strip()
po_header_id = str(p.get("po_header_id") or "").strip()

missing = [
    key
    for key, value in (("username", username), ("password", password), ("po_header_id", po_header_id))
    if not value
]
if missing:
    available = ", ".join(sorted(str(key) for key in p)) or "(none)"
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Missing required runtime params: {', '.join(missing)}. Available keys: {available}"
    )

submit_url = (
    f"{BASE_URL}/fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/draftPurchaseOrders/"
    f"{po_header_id}/action/submit"
)

resp = requests.post(
    submit_url,
    auth=HTTPBasicAuth(username, password),
    headers={
        "Content-Type": "application/vnd.oracle.adf.action+json",
        "Accept": "application/json",
    },
    data=json.dumps({}),
    timeout=60,
)

if not resp.ok:
    # Surface Oracle's actual error body instead of an opaque HTTPError.
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Submit PO request failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.reason}\n{resp.text}"
    )

data = resp.json() if resp.content else {}
print(f"Submitted draft PO {po_header_id}: {resp.status_code} {resp.reason}")
#time.sleep(180)
# Surface the action result for the report / downstream chaining.
extract("submitted_po_header_id", po_header_id)
if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("result") is not None:
    extract("submit_result", data["result"])
